title: ambrosia salsola var. fasciculata
intro: Ambrosia salsola var. fasciculata, commonly known as Western ragweed, is a flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Western ragweed include its ability to reduce fever, treat respiratory issues, and act as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of Western ragweed include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
